item.title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music industry update. If you're looking for a one-stop shop for music industry events, look no further than Billboard Pro's new events calendar.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: "This comprehensive calendar features major national and international events, including conferences, festivals, and networking mixers. Whether you're an artist, industry professional, or just a music enthusiast, this calendar has got you covered.
[Short pause]
Host: "Some highlights from the calendar include the globalFEST winter festival in New York on January 17th, 2027, the Grammy Awards in Los Angeles on February 7th, 2027, and the Electric Daisy Carnival, or EDC, in Las Vegas from May 13th to 24th, 2027.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "To stay up-to-date on the latest music industry events, check out Billboard Pro's events calendar. And if you're an event organizer, you can even get your event listed by contacting joe.maimone@billboard.com. That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
